title: Template Pool
description: Defines a template pool containing structure elements that can be connected via jigsaw blocks.

format_version.title: Format Version
format_version.description: The format version of this template pool definition.

minecraft:template_pool.title: Template Pool Definition
minecraft:template_pool.description:
The template pool definition.

Properties:
• description (object)
• elements
• fallback (string)

description.title: Description
description.description:
The description block containing the template pool identifier.

Properties:
• identifier (string)

elements.title: Elements
elements.description:
Array of pool elements that can be selected when generating structures.

Properties:
• element ({ element_type, location, processors, ... })
• weight (int) = 1

element.title: Element
element.description:
The structure element configuration.

Properties:
• element_type (string)
• location (string)
• processors (string)
• projection (string) = rigid

element_type.title: Element Type
element_type.description: The type of pool element. Valid values: 'minecraft:single_pool_element', 'minecraft:list_pool_element', 'minecraft:feature_pool_element', 'minecraft:empty_pool_element', 'minecraft:legacy_single_pool_element'.

location.title: Location
location.description: Path to the structure template file, relative to the structures folder.

processors.title: Processors
processors.description: Identifier of the processor list to apply to this element, or inline processor configuration.

projection.title: Projection
projection.description: How the element projects onto terrain. Valid values: 'rigid', 'terrain_matching'.

weight.title: Weight
weight.description: The relative weight for selecting this element. Higher weights are more likely to be chosen.

fallback.title: Fallback Pool
fallback.description: Optional fallback pool identifier to use when no elements can be placed.

identifier.title: identifier
identifier.description: Identifier of the template pool. Used by Jigsaw Structures to assign processors to Structure Templates.
